description: Send a WhatsApp message: text, media (by url, or base64 data up to 4 MiB) or a location. to is a phone number with its country code (digits) or a JID. Omit deviceId when the project has exactly one device. The message is queued; its status moves to sent, delivered and read.

deviceId.description: Device public id (dev_...); omit when the project has exactly one device

markReadFirst.description: Mark the chat read before sending

data.description: File content; up to whatsapp.mediaMaxBytes on the RPC and 4 MiB through MCP; use url for larger files

url.description: Public http(s) URL the server downloads

voice.description: Send audio/ogg as a voice note

mentions.description: Phone numbers (digits) mentioned in the text as @<digits>

projectId.description: UUID of the project; omit to use the credential's active project

replyTo.description: A message public id (msg_...) or a WhatsApp message id to quote

to.description: Recipient: phone number with country code (e.g. 628123456789) or a JID

name: message_send
title: Message send
